title: LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump Catalogue Row
seoTitle: LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump | Pinjin 145 kW 50 m³/h Xingtai
description: LZ-60 is a Xingtai diesel trailer pump: 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m, 5500 kg. Same HBT60-13.132 mark as Diesel 60, different table. Not a boom pump.

relatedPaths.label: LZ-60 diesel concrete pump product page

answerBlock.what: LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump is a diesel trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: model LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132, 6105 diesel 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m, 5500 kg. Hopper volume is not printed on this page. It is not Diesel 60 and not a boom pump.
answerBlock.who: Contractors matching 50 m³/h, 35 MPa and 100 m / 300 m on a 5500 kg diesel trailer, with stone at or under 4 cm.
factors: 145 kW / 50 m³/h / 35 MPa versus Diesel 60 at 144 kW / 35 m³/h / 30 MPa / 150 m / 350 m / 3500 kg
Both pages print HBT60-13.132 — open the named row
Pipe cell 100 / 125 mm; hopper m³ is not on the LZ-60 sheet
Alibaba showroom titles mix 15–90 m³ capacity strings; they do not rewrite this 50 m³/h cell

faqs.question: Does the LZ-60 page print a hopper volume?
faqs.answer: No. LZ-60 lists 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. Hopper m³ is not on that sheet. Diesel 60 prints hopper 0.4 m³ on its own page.

faqs.question: Can I use the Alibaba 15–90 m³ capacity title as the LZ-60 output?
faqs.answer: No. A March 2025 Alibaba trailer-pump showroom listing uses a 15-20-30-50-90 m³ capacity title. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Quote the Xingtai cell, not the marketplace title.
